title: Payment methods
description:
Use a sealed interface and pattern matching to handle different payments.

```
Card ending 4242: 25.00 charged
PayPal ada@example.com: 25.00 sent
Voucher SAVE10: 10.00 off, 15.00 left to pay
Fees: 0.75
```
hints: With a sealed interface, the compiler knows every case is covered, so it can refuse a `switch` that misses one.
requirements: `sealed interface Payment permits Card, PayPal, Voucher` with three records.
`describe(Payment p, double amount)` uses a `switch` with record patterns and no `default`.
`fee(Payment p, double amount)`: card 3%, PayPal 0, vouchers 0.
stretch: Add a `Split` payment that holds two other payments, and handle it recursively.
